name: Zhongnanshan Tunnel
facts: Zhongnanshan Tunnel, the longest two‑tube road tunnel in China, stretches 18,040 metres, making it the fifth longest road tunnel worldwide after Norway's Lærdal and Australia's WestConnex.
Opened on 20 January 2007, the tunnel cost 3.2 billion yuan (US$410 million) and sits up to 1,640 metres below the Zhongnan Mountains' surface.
Designed to carry the Xi'an‑Ankang Highway, Zhongnanshan Tunnel links the cities of Chang'an and Zhashui, cutting through the Qinling range in Shaanxi province.
